question: What principle is located in the middle of the karṇika and what is its form?
premises: The middle of the karṇika is the location.
The tāmasa principle is placed there.
It has the form of Blue Rudra.
inference: In the middle of the karṇika is the tāmasa principle in the form of Blue Rudra.
plain_english: In the middle of the karṇika is the tāmasa principle, having the form of Blue Rudra.
